micradrone.region_pointer.end_set: Region selected up to (%s, %s, %s) - open the IDE's Chat tab to use it
micradrone.region_pointer.no_start: Left-click a block first to set the start corner

advancements.micradrone.unlock_carrot.de: Spend wheat points to unlock carrot in the Corner Marker shop

advancements.micradrone.harvest_wheat_10: Harvest 1000 wheat - your drone never gets tired

micradrone.build.submit.ok: Plan received: %1$s blocks, about %2$s s. If it looks right: /micradrone build approve %3$s
micradrone.build.submit.issues: I cannot build it like this. There are %1$s problems.
micradrone.build.submit.busy: The last check is not finished yet. Please wait a little.
micradrone.build.submit.bad_source: I cannot read that plan file: %1$s
micradrone.build.partial: Almost done, but %1$s places could not be built.
micradrone.build.conflicts: Someone changed %1$s spots, so I left them alone.
micradrone.build.shortage: Not enough %1$s: %2$s short. Put them in your inventory or the supply chest.
micradrone.build.cancelled: Job %1$s stopped. What is built stays as it is.
micradrone.build.status.none: No jobs are running right now.
micradrone.build.confirm.terrain: I will cut %1$s blocks of ground and fill %2$s. If OK, add confirm-terraform to approve.
micradrone.build.confirm.destructive: I will replace %1$s water/lava, %2$s leaves and %3$s empty containers. If OK, add confirm-destructive.
micradrone.build.issue.site_unloaded: the spot is not loaded yet. Go closer and send it again.
micradrone.build.recover.ask: Job %1$s: I cannot tell whether %2$s happened before it stopped. If it did, choose /micradrone build recover %1$s adopt; if not, choose discard.
micradrone.build.rollback.ask: I will put the spot back as it was: %1$s blocks come out. If that is OK: /micradrone build rollback %2$s confirm
micradrone.build.halted: I could not write my notes down, so I stopped working.
micradrone.build.pause.owner_offline: waiting because the builder is away
micradrone.build.pause.chunk_unloaded: the spot is too far to load. Please go closer.
micradrone.build.pause.server_busy: the server is busy, so I am going slowly
micradrone.build.pause.no_room: your inventory is full and returned items do not fit. Make some room.
micradrone.build.pause.recovery_needed: the server stopped mid-way, so I cannot check how far it got. Ask a grown-up to run /micradrone build recover
micradrone.build.pause.site_changed: something was placed at the build spot. Move it, or skip it with /micradrone build resume %1$s skip-conflicts.
micradrone.build.pause.entity_in_way: Someone is standing where I want to build. Please step aside.
micradrone.build.reject.no_pending: no plan is waiting for approval. submit first.
micradrone.build.reject.expired: too much time passed. submit again.
micradrone.build.reject.hash_mismatch: the mark (hash) is different. submit again.
micradrone.build.reject.dimension_mismat: you are in a different world. approve in the same world.
micradrone.build.reject.registry_changed: the parts list changed. submit again.
micradrone.build.reject.survey_mismatch: the ground check does not match. submit again.
micradrone.build.reject.survey_expired: the ground check got old. submit again.
micradrone.build.reject.blocking_issues: there is a problem that must be fixed before building.
micradrone.build.reject.terraform_unconf: I will change the ground. Add confirm-terraform.
micradrone.build.reject.destructive_unco: I will replace water or leaves. Add confirm-destructive.
micradrone.build.reject.assembly_not_ava: the assembly parts cannot be built yet.
micradrone.build.control.not_allowed: you cannot change someone else's job.
micradrone.build.control.save_failed: the change could not be saved, so nothing was changed.
micradrone.build.issue.e_site_blocked: there is a block in the way that cannot be moved.
micradrone.build.issue.e_site_changed: the spot changed after it was checked.
micradrone.build.issue.e_out_of_bounds: it is too big or sticks out.
micradrone.build.issue.e_block_forbidden: a block that must not be placed is in it.
micradrone.build.issue.e_material_unknow: a material this game does not have is in it.
micradrone.build.issue.e_replace_unconfi: please confirm replacing water or leaves.
micradrone.build.issue.e_claim_overlap: it overlaps someone else's build spot.
micradrone.build.issue.e_claim_limit: build spots are full. Clean up ones you do not need.
micradrone.build.issue.e_claim_invalid: cannot do it at this build spot. Go close to your own spot.
micradrone.build.issue.e_registry_versio: the parts list version is different.
micradrone.build.issue.e_template_unveri: there is an unchecked assembly part.
micradrone.build.issue.e_site_missing: where to build is not decided.
micradrone.build.issue.e_param_range: a number is too big or too small.
micradrone.build.chat.consent: May I ask the AI to plan a building for you?
micradrone.build.chat.cli_missing: The AI helper is not installed yet. Ask a grown-up to install Claude Code.
micradrone.build.chat.ai_failed: The AI could not answer. Please try again.
micradrone.build.chat.plan_failed: I could not make a plan. Try asking in a different way.
micradrone.build.chat.offer: The plan is ready! %1$s blocks, about %2$s seconds.
micradrone.build.chat.offer_terrain: It will cut %1$s blocks of ground and fill %2$s.
micradrone.build.chat.place_in_front: It will be built in front of you. If that is OK, press Build.
micradrone.build.chat.partial: Almost done - %1$s places could not be built.
micradrone.build.chat.busy: I am still working on another request. Please wait for it.
micradrone.build.chat.approve_refused: Could not build here. Move somewhere else and try again
micradrone.build.chat.undo_ask: Really put everything back the way it was? The building will disappear.
micradrone.build.chat.undo_done: It is back to how it was before.
micradrone.build.chat.undo_partial: Almost back - %1$s places could not be put back.
micradrone.build.chat.undo_refused: It cannot be put back right now.
micradrone.build.chat.pause_recovery: The server stopped part-way. Please ask a grown-up.
micradrone.build.chat.pause_site_changed: Something was placed at the build spot. Move it, then ask a grown-up.
micradrone.build.chat.ask_inventory: The materials ran out. May I use your things too?
micradrone.build.chat.inventory_on: OK! I will use your things too.
micradrone.build.chat.inventory_off: OK! I will not use your things.
micradrone.build.chat.offer_source: The materials come from the chests - and from your things only if you say OK.
micradrone.build.chat.materials_changed: I heard your request about the materials.
micradrone.build.chat.materials_unclear: I did not understand the materials request. Please say it again.
micradrone.build.chat.materials_refused: I could not take the materials request.
